weeks.note: Post-Madeira rebuild. Vertical jump stays depressed ~18 days after an ultra, so nothing hard.

sessions.label: Long easy run 6 km, HR under 155. Aerobic base is the lever - the fastest runners get there on Zone 1 volume.
Swim 30 min - TECHNIQUE ONLY. Breathing, body position, catch. Distance is irrelevant for six weeks.
Easy 6 km, talk test. Warm up 15 min + strides finishing AT goal pace and no faster.
BIKE 30 min - sweet spot, 3 x 10-12 min at 88-93% FTP (~132-140 W), 5 min easy between. The 90 km bike is over half a 70.3 by time.
SWIM LESSON (1-on-1, 45 min). Book 6-10 of these - highest-ROI line item in the whole season. You cannot self-coach a catch you have never felt.

Strength - legs and upper alternating, 45 min. Trap-bar hinge, split squats, rows, press. LOWER-LEG AND FOOT, 5 min at the end: tibialis anterior raises 3 x 15-20, heel walks 2 x 20 m, eccentric dorsiflexion 3 x 10, short-foot holds 3 x 30 s per side. An 8-week RCT raised lactate threshold velocity 5.9% with intrinsic foot work.

Upper - push and pull as one session, 45 min. Rows, pull-ups, press, rear delts. Free against the running and cycling load, which is why it survives every reshuffle. Dead hangs 3 x max at the end - grip is a genuine weakness.
